company.name: Nomic
company.shortDescription: Nomic develops a proteomic technology platform to understand, detect, and treat diseases with DNA nanotechnology.
company.description: Nomic is a bioengineering company working to make the human proteome as broadly and easily accessible as the human genome. They are building the nELISA, a next-generation protein profiling platform for measuring proteins at scale and at high throughput. They offer scientists protein profiling solutions and empower them to decide the scope and scale of their experiments.

productsAndServices.description: A multiplexed immunoassay platform that enables high-throughput, quantitative protein profiling with minimized cross-reactivity.
productsAndServices.name: nELISA

productsAndServices.description: A proteomic panel profiling 1000 informative proteins with absolute quantification for broad biological and disease insights.
productsAndServices.name: Omni 1000

productsAndServices.description: A targeted proteomic panel covering key immune pathways and inflammatory markers for immune-related research.

productsAndServices.description: A targeted proteomic panel providing deep coverage of cardiac and metabolic biology for cardiometabolic research.

productsAndServices.description: A customizable protein profiling service allowing selection of any targets from Nomic's library to build tailored panels.

productsAndServices.description: An industrial-scale, mail-in protein profiling service based on nELISA technology with end-to-end expert support.
productsAndServices.name: Nomic Protein Profiling Service
